quarterly_data.quarter: Tempus AI press release: Tempus Secures Up to $9.5 Million in ARPA-H ADVOCATE (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Tempus was selected by ARPA-H (the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health, within the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services) to receive an award of up to $9.5 million under its ADVOCATE program to build an autonomous clinical AI agent for patients with heart failure, which the company calls the first of its kind (company claim); the funding supports product development and clinical validation of the AI system in a multi-center prospective study. The agent builds on Tempus' existing AI products, including the Olivia agentic patient concierge, Tempus Next care-gap software that has already screened over 2.7 million cardiology patients, and a portfolio of three FDA-cleared ECG-AI products.
quarterly_data.figure: award of up to $9.5 million; Tempus Next has screened over 2.7 million cardiology patients; three FDA-cleared ECG-AI products
